about: Faults put by hand into code the goal agent accepted, to test the critics rather than the writer. Each replaces one line of the accepted feature; `run.py critic-test` applies it, runs the gates, and takes it out again. The critics are shown the whole files, not the edit.

faults.what: Ties go to the least recently levelled special instead of the most recent
The copy of a Lv 3 special keeps Ryo's evolution
A full tie goes to the higher slot instead of the lower
